contents.text:
# Safe tempo workflow

1. Call live_status and live_snapshot to establish the adapter and epoch.
2. Call live_tempo_preview; preview never mutates Live and returns a transactionId.
3. Call live_tempo_apply with confirmation=apply and a fresh idempotencyKey.
4. Call live_snapshot to verify the authoritative tempo.
5. Call live_undo with confirmation=undo to restore the captured tempo when no newer change intervened.

content.text: Use tools/call with name audio_analyze and caller-supplied little-endian float32 PCM. Provide sampleRate in Hz. Optionally provide channels.
Use tools/call with name audio_analyze and caller-supplied little-endian float32 PCM. Provide sampleRate in Hz. Optionally provide channels.
Use tools/call with name audio_analyze and caller-supplied little-endian float32 PCM. Use sampleRate=44100 Hz. Use channels=2.
Use tools/call with name audio_analyze and caller-supplied little-endian float32 PCM. Use sampleRate=null Hz. Use channels=1,,2.
Use tools/call with name audio_analyze and caller-supplied little-endian float32 PCM. Use sampleRate=[object Object] Hz. Optionally provide channels.
